ui.invalid: Not a valid choice, please try again.
setup.welcome: First use: let's set up ant-peer-review.
setup.backend.claude-cli: claude-cli — uses your Claude Code login (cheapest with a subscription)
setup.backend.anthropic-api: anthropic-api — Anthropic API key, pay per token (coming soon)
setup.backend_unavailable: {backend} is not available yet; please choose another.
setup.models: Peer reviewer models (2 or more recommended: they split the work and review each other):
setup.model_unavailable: Model {model} is unavailable and was not saved: {reason}
run.resume_choice: What would you like to do?
run.phase_skip: ✓ Phase {phase} already done, inputs unchanged — skipped
intake.targets_help: Enter targets, one per line: a URL (https://example.com/post), a folder or file path (./drafts), or paste text. Finish with /done on its own line, or press Enter twice.
intake.need_target: Please enter at least one target.
rubric.title: Scoring criteria and weights (total 100):
report.title: Review report
report.warn.fewer_than_two_reviewers: Fewer than 2 reviewers answered; findings are not cross-checked.
report.warn.single_vendor_correlated_err: All reviewers come from one vendor; their errors may be correlated, so agreement is not independent confirmation.
report.provisional: provisional: red lines await a ruling
report.scurve_not_scored: stage not verified, not scored (weight returned to Impact)
report.split_scores: Dimensions where reviewers' scores differ by 25 or more
report.label: Consensus
report.unverified: Findings set aside: they rest on unverified facts
report.injection_note: Untrusted original evidence below; it was withheld from reviewers. No flag does not prove there is no injection.
fc.later: Continue another time — save and exit
fc.finalize: Stop and finalize — compare with the last report
fc.unchanged: No fact changed since report v{v}: the report result is unchanged.
fc.updated: Facts changed: wrote report v{v} with a changelog.
fc.no_report: No report yet; finish the run first (ant-peer-review resume {run}).
decide.plan.A: Plan A — line edit (07-revision/A.md, diff in A.diff)
decide.plan.manual: Manual edit — I will provide my own final file
decide.manual_path: Path to your edited file (Enter = start from A.md as final.md):
decide.style_proposal: These corrections keep recurring for brand {brand}; add them to its Style Guide?
decide.style_confirm: Write these rules to the Style Guide?
lessons.second_time: Area {area} already has a lesson ({ids}). The same mistake twice should become a rule, not more text.
lessons.promote_hint: Consider turning it into a Style Guide rule or a default setting.
lessons.promote: Turn it into a site rule?
lessons.promote.ua: Add contact details to our User-Agent for this site (it still says ant-peer-review)
lessons.rule: Rule (what to do from now on):
intake.brand: Brand name for the Style Guide (Enter to skip):
sources.lesson_hint: tip: if this site keeps failing ({reason}), record it: ant-peer-review lessons new "<title>" --area crawl/<domain>
sources.failed: {n} target(s) could not be read. What now?
review.failed: These reviewers did not answer: {models}. What now?
review.without: Continue without them (disclosed in the report)
draft.again: Draft not good enough yet: writing round {round} with the findings as feedback.
decide.hint: Review done. To finish, run: ant-peer-review decide {run} --choice A|B|manual [--rule <red_line>=confirmed|dismissed]
run.interrupted: Interrupted; progress saved. Resume with: ant-peer-review resume {run}
ui.toggle_custom: Toggle numbers (e.g. 1 3), c = add a custom value, Enter to confirm (nothing ticked = skip):
run.delete_confirm: Delete {run} and its {n} file(s)? This cannot be undone.
ui.keys_radio: ↑↓ move · Enter choose · number keys pick directly · Esc cancel
ui.keys_multi: ↑↓ move · Space tick · Enter confirm · Esc cancel
feed.pick: This feed lists {n} articles (a feed may show only the latest ones). Which should be reviewed? Each becomes its own run.
feed.picked: Feed: reviewing the newest {n} of the {total} it lists (a feed may show only its latest items), one run each; change with --feed-limit
revision.coverage: Coverage: plan A {a}, plan B {b}, both {both}, not handled {none} (07-revision/coverage.json)
recheck.title: Revision check against {parent} (report v{v})
recheck.no_findings: {run} has no consensus findings yet; finish it first.
feed.scale: That is {n} runs with {m} reviewers each; every run makes about {calls} model calls plus its fact checks.
feed.scale_confirm: Go ahead with all of them?
feed.nothing: Nothing to review; no run was created.
intake.fact_sources: Extra fact-check sources (web search is always used):
intake.fact_sources.academic: Academic identifiers (DOI / arXiv): verify cited papers exist, match their titles and are not retracted, via doi.org, Crossref and arXiv
sources.paste_for: Paste the text of {url} (end with /done or two empty lines):
sources.paste_hint: tip: save the page yourself (you may have access the crawler does not) and pass it as --target <file>, or paste its text as --target.
lessons.promote.needs_js: Always render {domain} with the headless browser
sources.blocked_archive: A Wayback Machine copy from {date} exists.
sources.use_archive: Use the archive copy for the {n} refused page(s)
sources.blocked_hint: tip: to read the archive copy of a page that refused us, run again with --archive-on-block; or save the page yourself and pass --target <file>.
decide.rl.desc.illegal: content that is illegal or helps someone break the law
decide.rl.desc.hallucination: a serious factual error, or a made-up fact, quote, figure or source
decide.rl.desc.pr_landmine: something insensitive, inflammatory or defamatory that could hurt the brand
decide.rl.desc.plagiarism: copied text, or copyright or trademark infringement
decide.rl.desc.sensitive_politics: one-sided or sensitive political content likely to cause backlash
decide.rl.desc.human_rights: content demeaning a race, gender or sexual orientation, or violating human rights
decide.rl.effect: Confirm = veto: the piece fails whatever its score. Dismiss = no veto; the issues stay in the report and the score is unchanged.
decide.rl.why_ledger: Why you are asked: fact-checking found {n} unsupported statement(s), but no reviewer flagged this red line.
decide.rl.why_dissent: Why you are asked: {who} flagged it and {against} objected.
decide.rl.why_single: Why you are asked: only {who} flagged it; a veto needs two reviewers.
decide.rl.warning_only: name or translation: warning only, not evidence
decide.rl.reviewers: Each reviewer on this red line:
decide.postponed: Ruling kept pending. When you are ready, run: ant-peer-review decide {run}
setup.single_reviewer: Only {model} is selected: there will be no cross-review, and every finding is a single opinion. {n} or more are recommended. Go on with one reviewer?
run.banner_single: One reviewer: no cross-review, every finding is a single opinion ({n}+ recommended).
report.process.no_debate: none, only one reviewer ({models}); there was no cross-review.
report.process.conclusion: total {total}, {grade}; all reviewers agreed on {agreed} of {n} finding(s); veto: {vetoes}.
report.process.single: With one reviewer every finding is a single opinion.
more.no_feed: Run {run} was not made from a feed, so there is no article list to return to. Start one with: ant-peer-review new --target <feed URL>
run.more_hint: To review more articles from this feed: ant-peer-review more {run}
analysis.title: Content check
analysis.author: Author
analysis.size: Length: {units} units (CJK characters or words), {paras} paragraphs, {heads} headings
analysis.link_heavy: {n} links in the article body: this may be an index page; the articles it links to are not read
analysis.mode.sections: key sections (introduction, headings, conclusion, references, ending)
analysis.mode.head_tail_random: beginning, end and 5 random paragraphs (no clear structure)
analysis.preselected: The next questions are preselected from this check; change anything you like.
analysis.skipped: The analysis was skipped ({reason}); the questions are asked without preselection.
intake.brand_default: Brand name for the Style Guide (Enter = {brand}):
